svg.title: Sketching the derivative from the graph of f
svg.desc: Top: f(x) = x cubed over 3 minus x squared minus 3x plus 2, with a peak at x = -1, a valley at x = 3 and an inflection point at x = 1. Bottom, on the same x-scale: f'(x) = x squared minus 2x minus 3. Dashed lines show that f' is zero at x = -1 and x = 3, where f turns, and that f' has its lowest point at x = 1, where f changes concavity. f' is positive where f rises and negative where f falls.
